title: In conversation with Richard Andersen
abstract: As part of our special issue on neurotechnology, we spoke with Richard Andersen, James G. Boswell Professor of Neuroscience at Caltech, about the discoveries that helped to establish the posterior parietal cortex as a key hub for intention and action planning. He looks back on decades of discoveries in the posterior parietal cortex and discusses how advances in neural recording, decoding and computation are reshaping our understanding of cognition.
abstract_zh: 作为我们神经技术专题的一部分，我们与加州理工学院詹姆斯·G·博斯韦尔神经科学教授理查德·安德森进行了交谈，讨论了帮助确立后顶叶作为意图和动作规划关键枢纽的发现。他回顾了数十年来在后顶叶的发现，并讨论了神经录制、解码和计算的进步如何重塑我们对认知的理解。
